text.insert: Tracing is the epilogue of system execution: durable events explain how accepted state came to be, scheduler signals explain why sleeping work resumed, and trace links connect those facts to runtime spans. Durable workflow state remains authoritative for the current snapshot.

props.title: Tracing contract map
rows: Identity, causation, correlation, actor credit, and one-event/one-revision provenance.
The closed vocabulary accepted by the event store, grouped by workflow domain.
Authority transfer, cycle facts, transactional spooling, and idempotent replay.

Bounded inspection, safe projections, cause resolution, and pagination.
Runtime-span joins and the operator timeline.
The boundary between scheduler wake signals and accepted game facts.
